items.title: What Could UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Face From New CMS Audits And Breakup Pressure?
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE: UNH) faces a new CMS proposal to tighten Medicare and Medicaid anti-fraud audits and oversight. The draft CMS rule would expand data reviews of managed care plans, potentially increasing compliance and documentation requirements for UnitedHealth. Separate breakup legislation backed by Senator Elizabeth Warren targets vertically integrated healthcare conglomerates that combine insurance, clinics, and pharmacy services.
